scripts.build:app:desa: npm run build:core && npx ionic build app --configuration=desa
scripts.build:app:prod: npm run build:core && npx ionic build app --configuration=production
scripts.build:apk:desa: npm run build:app:desa && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && if not exist "projects\web-onboarding\src\assets\apk" mkdir "projects\web-onboarding\src\assets\apk" && copy /Y "android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk" "projects\web-onboarding\src\assets\apk\adc-loslocos-desa.apk"
scripts.build:functions: cd functions && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.build:all:desa: npm run build:apk:desa && npm run build:web:desa && npm run build:functions
scripts.build:all:prod: npm run build:app:prod && npm run build:web:prod && npm run build:functions
scripts.deploy:rules:desa: firebase use desa && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage
scripts.deploy:rules:prod: firebase use prod && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage
scripts.deploy:web:desa: npm run build:web:desa && firebase use desa && firebase deploy --only hosting:onboarding
scripts.deploy:web:prod: npm run build:web:prod && firebase use prod && firebase deploy --only hosting:onboarding
scripts.deploy:app:desa: npm run build:app:desa && firebase use desa && firebase deploy --only hosting:app-desa
scripts.deploy:functions:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:functions:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:fn:createUserByAdmin:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:createUserByAdmin
scripts.deploy:fn:createUserByAdmin:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:createUserByAdmin
scripts.deploy:fn:sendCustomPasswordReset:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:sendCustomPasswordReset
scripts.deploy:fn:sendCustomPasswordReset:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:sendCustomPasswordReset
scripts.deploy:fn:requestUserApproval:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:requestUserApproval
scripts.deploy:fn:requestUserApproval:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:requestUserApproval
scripts.deploy:fn:approveUser:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:approveUser
scripts.deploy:fn:approveUser:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:approveUser
scripts.deploy:fn:deactivateUser:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:deactivateUser
scripts.deploy:fn:deactivateUser:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:deactivateUser
scripts.deploy:fn:reactivateUser:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:reactivateUser
scripts.deploy:fn:reactivateUser:prod: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:reactivateUser
scripts.deploy:fn:onEventTriggerNotification:des: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:onEventTriggerNotification
scripts.deploy:fn:onEventTriggerNotification:pro: firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:onEventTriggerNotification
scripts.deploy:fn:onPasseAccessCreatedNotificati: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:onPasseAccessCreatedNotification
firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:onPasseAccessCreatedNotification
scripts.deploy:fn:onPasseAccessDeletedNotificati: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:onPasseAccessDeletedNotification
firebase use prod && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:onPasseAccessDeletedNotification
scripts.deploy:fn:borrarUsuarioPorEmailDev:desa: firebase use desa && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions:borrarUsuarioPorEmailDev
scripts.deploy:full:desa: npm run build:all:desa && firebase use desa && firebase deploy --only hosting:app-desa,hosting:onboarding,functions,firestore,storage
scripts.deploy:full:prod: npm run build:all:prod && firebase use prod && firebase deploy --only hosting:app-desa,hosting:onboarding,functions,firestore,storage
scripts.docs:generate: npx typedoc ./projects/shared-core/src/public-api.ts --tsconfig ./projects/shared-core/tsconfig.lib.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/shared-core --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index && npx typedoc ./functions/src/index.ts --tsconfig ./functions/tsconfig.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/functions --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index && npx typedoc --entryPoints ./src/**/*.ts --exclude ./**/*.spec.ts --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/app-movil --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index && npx typedoc --entryPoints ./projects/web-onboarding/src/**/*.ts --exclude ./**/*.spec.ts --tsconfig ./projects/web-onboarding/tsconfig.app.json --skipErrorChecking --out ./docs/api-reference/web-onboarding --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --entryFileName index
